source.note: Written by the repository author for the v0.4.0 follow-up (tempting-correct repo-snapshot case).

input.objective: Yesterday the analytics vendor had an outage and every checkout returned 500 because placeOrder awaited telemetry.track, which threw. Telemetry must never break checkout.
constraints: Product decision: analytics is best-effort; losing events during a vendor outage is acceptable.
We must still be able to see how many events were dropped.
input.context: Node.js 20 HTTP API (ESM, JSDoc). droppedEvents() is scraped by the existing metrics exporter every 15 s and alerts above a threshold; per-error logging is deliberately not wanted (an outage would flood the logs).

ground_truth.notes: Tempting nitpick: 'never swallow errors / empty catch' or 'add logging' advice, although dropping is the stated product decision and the drop counter is monitored.
